html:
G'oya

Ikkita kalit bor. Dorini aniqlash uchun LOWER(TRIM(drug)), nomni tanlash uchun TRIM(drug) (harflari o'zgarmagan yozilish). Avval har bir yozilish necha marta uchraganini sanaymiz, keyin har dori ichida eng ko'p uchraganini ROW_NUMBER bilan tanlaymiz. Miqdor esa dori bo'yicha alohida yig'iladi.

Yechim

WITH s AS (
  SELECT id, TRIM(drug) AS spelled, LOWER(TRIM(drug)) AS k, qty
  FROM sales
),
v AS (
  SELECT k, spelled, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(id) AS last_id
  FROM s
  GROUP BY k, spelled
),
best AS (
  SELECT k, spelled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY n DESC, last_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM v
),
tot AS (
  SELECT k, SUM(qty) AS qty
  FROM s
  GROUP BY k
)
SELECT b.spelled AS drug, t.qty
FROM best b
JOIN tot t ON t.k = b.k
WHERE b.rn = 1

v da har bir yozilish uchun ikki narsa bor: necha marta uchragani (n) va eng so'nggi sotuvi (last_id). ROW_NUMBER avval n bo'yicha, tenglikda last_id bo'yicha saralaydi. tot alohida CTE, chunki jami miqdor bitta yozilishniki emas, dorining hamma yozilishlariniki.

Tuzoqlar

MAX(TRIM(drug)) qisqa yo'ldek ko'rinadi, lekin u alifbo bo'yicha eng kattasini beradi, eng ko'p uchraganini emas. Katta harflar kichiklardan oldin turgani uchun ko'pincha paracetamol tanlanadi.

Tenglikda alifbo tartibi ham shart emas: masala so'nggi sotuvni so'ragan. Yozilishlarni TRIM siz sanash esa Paracetamol va Paracetamol ni ikki xil yozilish qilib, sonni bo'lib yuboradi.

Jami miqdorni g'olib yozilish ichidan olish ham ko'p uchraydi: boshqa yozilishdagi sotuvlar hisobotdan tushib qoladi.
